notes: This is a Form IV verb. It is commonly used for finishing a task, a project, or a period of time.
Be careful not to confuse this with 'انتهى' (intahā), which is the passive/intransitive form meaning 'to come to an end' by itself, while 'أنهى' (anhā) requires a subject doing the finishing.
